user.title: Set up Sporet
user.description: Sign in at sporet.no, then open the browser console (F12) and run `copy(localStorage['oidc.user:https://login.sporet.no:geodata-public'])`. Paste the result below - it contains a refresh token, so this only has to be done once.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Sporet again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved login is no longer valid. Sign in at sporet.no, then open the browser console (F12) and run `copy(localStorage['oidc.user:https://login.sporet.no:geodata-public'])`. Paste the result below - it contains a refresh token, so this only has to be done once.
